experiment: STRUCTURED-SLOT CARRY: an IN-BAND method that grows directly from the erasure law. The law: free-text re-summarization kills a fact because every hop REGENERATES it (a lossy channel -> drift/erasure that compounds with hop count). The method: change the operation from REGENERATION to TRANSCRIPTION -- put the fragile fact in a [SLOTS] block the compressor reproduces VERBATIM; only the [NOTES] prose is compressed. Tests whether an in-band structured carry beats free-text handoff (current practice) and matches an out-of-band store, with NO external infrastructure.
grows_from_law: Directly exploits the mechanism established earlier (numbers die by high-surprisal erasure + tokenization drift under repeated regeneration). Externally corroborated Jan 2026: arXiv 2601.03640 shows verbatim transcription collapses as N grows (44%->0% at N>=300) under regeneration; arXiv 2601.00821 shows storing verbatim beats extract-and-summarize because extraction loses numbers. Our lever = replace per-hop regeneration of the fact with per-hop copy.
design: Sonnet, temp=0. Per fact-type, PROBES=12 probe facts, each planted with NDIST=7 mixed-type distractors (real contention), run K=6 handoff hops (budget=25 words), then queried. Same probe, same distractors, same K -> only the CARRY REPRESENTATION differs across 4 arms.

arms.neutral: probe mixed into a free-text summary, recompressed each hop. = current practice / SOTA lower bound (naive re-summarization).
arms.reinject: probe restated verbatim each hop, THEN the whole carry recompressed (DROPWATCH). Still REGENERATION -> our known in-band failure; controls for 'just repeat it'.
arms.slots_regen: SAME [SLOTS]/[NOTES] structure as ours, but the [SLOTS] section is REWRITTEN in the model's own words each hop. Isolates STRUCTURE-alone (the PACT/typed-handoff effect) from the copy operation.
arms.slots_copy: [OURS] probe in a [SLOTS] block the model must reproduce VERBATIM; [NOTES] compressed. Structure + TRANSCRIPTION.

baselines_vs_sota: Reviewer-expected baselines (from SOTA scan): (1) naive free-text re-summarization = our 'neutral'; (2) structured typed-slot carry that re-summarizes slots = our 'slots_regen' (the honest isolation the scan recommends); (3) external retrieval of the raw fact = our out-of-band UEP store (survival 1.0 by construction, already measured). Closest prior art = Structured Distillation for Personalized Agent Memory (arXiv 2603.13017): it measures per-field-type retention but optimizes one-shot retrieval recall, does NOT use copy-vs-regeneration as the lever, and does NOT select fields by measured multi-hop handoff survival. PACT (2606.05304) shows typed handoffs beat free text but never measures number survival. Differentiation: our lever is transcription-vs-regeneration, our metric is multi-hop numeric half-life, and field selection is measurement-driven.

PRE_REGISTERED_READOUT.BEATS_SOTA: slots_copy survival on NUMERIC is strictly and substantially higher than neutral (the free-text SOTA baseline) AND higher than reinject AND higher than slots_regen; i.e. copy_minus_neutral(numeric) large positive AND copy_minus_regen(numeric) large positive. -> the causal lever is TRANSCRIPTION (not merely structure), and an in-band copy-slot rescues numbers that free-text/regeneration cannot. slot_verbatim (fraction where the slot line survives literally) high, confirming the mechanism.
PRE_REGISTERED_READOUT.STRUCTURE_NOT_COPY: slots_copy ~ slots_regen and both > neutral -> the win is from STRUCTURE, not copy; weaker/derivative of PACT; report honestly and pivot the novelty to measurement-driven selection.
PRE_REGISTERED_READOUT.FAILS: slots_copy ~ neutral -> even a verbatim-copy instruction does not survive repeated compression (the model degrades the slot block under budget pressure); in-band structure cannot rescue numbers; out-of-band store remains the only solution. Report and fall back to the UEP allocation story.

predictions.point: slots_copy >> neutral on numeric and entity (the fragile, non-self-correcting types), approaching the out-of-band 1.0 line; slots_copy >> slots_regen (transcription is the lever, not structure); reinject ~ neutral (restating-then-regenerating does not help). slot_verbatim tracks slots_copy survival.
predictions.risk: Under a tight 25-word NOTES budget the model may bleed budget into rewriting slots, or drop the [SLOTS] header after several hops -> slots_copy decays too. If slot_verbatim is high but grade is low, the answer-extraction (not transcription) is the failure. If both low, transcription itself failed under compression.
predictions.honest_limits: single model (Sonnet); n=12 probes/type; K=6 single depth; one slot per carry (multi-slot contention deferred); the measurement-driven WHICH-fields-to-slot integration is a follow-up once the mechanism is shown.
